summary: On May 11, 2026, PMGC Holdings Inc. entered a Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of A B Aerospace, Inc. for $4,500,000 cash, with $4,275,000 paid at closing and $225,000 held for indemnification. Additional consideration includes estimated closing cash balance and net working capital adjustments. The acquisition closed May 12, 2026. The target's president continues post-closing under an employment agreement. The company now holds aerospace operations in addition to its pharmaceutical business. Watch post-closing integration and any litigation developments related to the indemnification holdback.
